name: folder-memory
description: Per-directory AGENTS.md project memory: auto-creates folder memory stubs on new directories and keeps a concise root directory index that Codex uses to find files without scanning the repo.

interface.shortDescription: Folder memory as a lookup index over your codebase
interface.longDescription: Keeps one AGENTS.md per folder plus a root directory index. Hooks scaffold memory for new folders and remind Codex to fill or refresh it; the memory-indexer skill makes Codex walk the index instead of grepping the whole repository.
defaultPrompt: Fill the pending folder memories and the root index TODOs
